entities.name: Lim-Dûl's War
entities.description: Conflict on Shandalar in which Lim-Dûl's undead army was defeated through the creation of the Great Barrier.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: Necromancer who invaded Shandalar with an undead army and survives by transferring his soul.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: Mana-rich plane that Lim-Dûl sought to seize.

entities.name: Ardestan
entities.description: Last city of Shandalar, besieged by Lim-Dûl.

entities.name: Kenan Sahrmal
entities.description: Protector of Shandalar who trained two adepts after his apparent death at Lim-Dûl's hands.

entities.name: Azar
entities.description: Adept of Sahrmal who stole a spell to imprison Lim-Dûl and ended up trapped with him.

entities.name: Great Barrier
entities.description: Magical barrier around Shandalar created by Azar's spell and dependent on Lim-Dûl's confinement.

entities.name: War for Shandalar
entities.description: Earlier war in which Faralyn, Tevesh Szat and Leshrac were repelled.

entities.name: Faralyn
entities.description: Repelled from Shandalar in the War for Shandalar.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: Repelled from Shandalar in the War for Shandalar.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: Repelled from Shandalar in the War for Shandalar.

entities.name: Wizards' War
entities.description: Later war in which Lim-Dûl attacks Shandalar again.

events.summary: Twelve years after the War for Shandalar, Lim-Dûl reappears with an undead army and destroys city after city until only Ardestan remains.
events.quote: City after city on the plane was destroyed until, after years of war, only one city remained, Ardestan .

events.summary: During the siege, Sahrmal counsels patience but Azar leaves their sanctuary to defend Ardestan; Sahrmal and the other apprentice go to aid him.
events.quote: Azar, unable to witness the suffering and inevitable fall of Ardestan without doing something about it, left their hidden sanctuary

events.summary: Azar prepares to cast a stolen spell to imprison Lim-Dûl's spirit and raise a Great Barrier; Lim-Dûl waits nearby.
events.quote: Lim-Dûl was prepared, however, and waited nearby.

events.summary: Lim-Dûl counters by trying to transfer into Azar's body; the combined spells trap both spirits in Azar's body and the Great Barrier comes into existence.
events.quote: The combined spells had the unforeseen effect of trapping both spirits within Azar’s body.

events.summary: Sahrmal secretly buries Azar's body, ending the war.
events.quote: Saddened, Sahrmal secretly buried the body

relations.quote: he had been training two adepts. One was Azar
Since his apparent death at the hands of Lim-Dûl
Ardestan became the last refuge against the evil necromancer, defended by Commander Bani Bakur .
